description:
Because:

- The root package.json pinned find-up to ^5.0.0.
- find-up 6 is ESM only, so the code and Jest must load it as ESM.

This commit:

- Upgrades find-up to ^6.3.0 and removes the unused entry from fxa-shared.
- Uses findUpSync in the nest-health version helper.
- Adds find-up and its ESM deps to transformIgnorePatterns in jest.preset.js.

Closes FXA-5409
